name: Hunan Meihu Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd.
summary: Hunan Meihu Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of oil pumps in China and internationally. The company's products comprising diesel/gasoline engine oil pumps, motors, transmission oil pumps, electric pumps, modular products, water pumps, mechanical and electric control variable displacement oil pumps, fuel pumps, gearboxes, hydraulic pumps, cooling water pumps, transmission pumps, integrated module products, hardened reducers, and precision gears, as well as high precision ferrous and die castings. It also offers after-sales services. Hunan Meihu Intelligent Manufacturing Co., Ltd. was founded in 1949 and is based in Hengdong, China.
